description:

**Description**
**Ready to help drive automation across a global business at Scan-IT?**
You enjoy finding smarter ways of working and turning manual processes into efficient, automated solutions. You solve problems, improve workflows, and build tools that make a real difference for users and teams.
  
  
At Scan-IT, we use automation to simplify processes, improve efficiency, and support the continued growth of our global business. As an Automation Engineer, you will design, build, and maintain automation solutions that streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, and deliver measurable value across teams and regions.
  
  
We’re a global technology company powering international logistics at scale. As part of Scan-Group – operating across shipping and logistics, technology, and leisure – we build and run the technology behind Shipco Transport, one of the world’s leading neutral NVOCCs, and sit at the heart of the infrastructure that keeps global trade moving. Backed by a strong international organization, we offer stability with the pace and energy of a growing tech team.
  
  
Working closely with business stakeholders and technical teams, you will translate operational requirements into practical automation solutions that improve accuracy, consistency, and productivity. From developing new workflows to enhancing existing automations, you will play an important role in helping teams work smarter and more efficiently across the organization.
  
  
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys hands-on development, solving problems, and creating automation solutions that make a tangible impact on how people work every day.
  
  
**What You'll Do…**

* **Backend Automation & Data Pipeline Development:**
  Design, develop, test, and deploy resilient backend automation pipelines, data transformations, and reconciliation engines using Python and modern scripting frameworks to process high-volume operational and financial transactions.
* **Financial Reconciliation & Multi-Way Matching Engines:**
  Engineer specialized data-matching algorithms and business rules to automate complex shared-service accounting workflows—specifically carrier freight invoice vouchering (cross-referencing vendor bills against buy accruals in Phoenix ERP within configurable tolerance thresholds) and Statement of Account (SOA) reconciliations.
* **Workflow Optimization & Process Simplification:**
  Analyze existing operational processes and evaluate opportunities to streamline workflows, eliminate manual touchpoints, and enhance data consistency. Work closely with shared service teams to assess whether business challenges can be resolved by standardizing source data formats, improving SOPs, or configuring ERP parameters before engineering automated software solutions.
* **Cost-Effective AI Integration & Prompt Workflows:**
  Apply AI-assisted automation, structured document parsing, and prompt-based pipelines where rule-based logic is insufficient. Evaluate the operational unit economics of AI components, ensuring that API query costs remain significantly lower than manual labor costs, and implement efficient schema parsing (JSON) to avoid excessive LLM token usage.
* **Database Management & Transaction Auditing:**
  Design and maintain relational database tables, state management stores, and task queues (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Redis) to support transaction deduplication, audit logging, idempotent execution, and operational reporting across all automated workflows.
* **API Development & System Connectivity:**
  Build, consume, and support RESTful API integrations and backend microservices (e.g., FastAPI/Flask) that bridge core systems (Phoenix ERP, domestic TMS platforms) with external logistics feeds, EDI translators, and shared service portals.
* **Human-in-the-Loop Dashboard Integration:**
  Develop and integrate backend data endpoints for lightweight Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) review interfaces (such as Streamlit, Retool, or custom web forms), enabling operations staff to review and adjust flagged line-item discrepancies seamlessly before final ERP commitment.
* **Automation Support & Troubleshooting:**
  Monitor backend automation pipelines, investigate data discrepancies, analyze system logs, and resolve production incidents to ensure reliable, uninterrupted, and fault-tolerant operation.
* **Business Collaboration & Requirements Gathering:**
  Work closely with business stakeholders, financial controllers, operational subject matter experts, and technical team members to translate functional business rules into practical technical specifications.
* **Documentation & Knowledge Sharing:**
  Create and maintain technical documentation, data dictionary mappings, API specifications, and operational runbooks to ensure smooth knowledge transfer and maintainability across the global tech organization.

**What You’ll Need…**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 3 to 5 years of progressive experience in software automation, backend data engineering, Python development, or technical automation roles.
* Advanced proficiency in Python with deep hands-on expertise in data manipulation and integration libraries (pandas, NumPy, openpyxl, SQLAlchemy, requests, pydantic).
* Experience with unit testing (pytest), automated CI/CD deployment pipelines (GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps), and data privacy controls.
* Strong experience building reconciliation and rules engines: Demonstrated track record of designing automated multi-way matching logic for financial or operational data (handling numerical tolerances, date windows, currency conversions, and discrepancy tracking).
* Solid understanding of Relational Databases & SQL: Proficiency in designing schemas, writing optimized complex queries, stored procedures, and managing state logging in SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
* Experience working with APIs and structured data: Hands-on experience developing and consuming RESTful APIs, handling webhooks, and parsing structured/semi-structured data (JSON, XML, CSV, Excel).
* Awareness of AI Cost Governance & Practical Application: Familiarity integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) into backend workflows with a practical mindset—understanding when deterministic rules are superior to AI and how to evaluate API token costs against manual effort.
* Strong Process Analysis & Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to map complex processes, identify root causes of inefficiencies, and advocate for process optimization or SOP improvements prior to implementing automation.
* Familiarity with RPA and workflow automation tools (such as Power Automate, UiPath, or n8n) and experience collaborating with RPA developers on hybrid automations.
* Experience with version control (Git) and modern software engineering practices (unit testing, containerization with Docker, CI/CD).
* Domain knowledge in Logistics, Freight Forwarding, or Supply Chain Shared Services (familiarity with carrier invoicing, vouchering, SOA reconciliation, Bills of Lading, or ERP finance workflows) is a strong advantage.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to translate technical logic to business stakeholders and support operational users effectively.

**Here’s What We Offer…**
At Scan-IT, we pride ourselves on our vibrant and supportive culture. Join our dynamic, international team and take on meaningful responsibilities from day one.
  
  
**Innovative Environment**
: Explore new technologies in the transportation and logistics industry.
  
**Collaborative Culture**
: Work with some of the industry’s best in an open and creative environment.
  
**Professional Growth**
: Benefit from continuous learning, mentorship, and career advancement.
  
**Impactful Work**
: Enhance efficiency and drive global success.
  
**Inclusive Workplace**
: Thrive in a diverse and supportive environment.
  
**Competitive Compensation**
: Receive a salary that reflects your expertise.
  
**Growth Opportunities**
: Achieve your full potential with ample professional and personal development opportunities.
  
  
Join Scan-IT and be part of a team that’s shaping the future of the transportation and logistics industry.

description:
**Roboyo AI is a category shaper in Applied AI and Agentic Automation.**

We help leading enterprises move from automation projects and AI experiments into governed, production-grade systems that execute real work across workflows, processes, products and services.

 

Our heritage is in scaled enterprise automation; our future is Applied AI and Agentic Automation: autonomous agents, AI engineering squads, process orchestration, data and knowledge foundations, and human-in-the-loop governance embedded deeply into how our clients operate.

 

We are not here to sell AI theatre. We are here to turn AI into working systems, measurable outcomes and repeatable transformation programs.

 

**ROLE SUMMARY**

 

This is an end-to-end ownership role. The Senior Business Analyst (BSA) is accountable for the business-facing thread of an automation or AI initiative from first stakeholder conversation to post-production stabilisation. You will run process discovery and feasibility assessment, define and baseline requirements, partner with architects and developers through build, own functional and user acceptance testing, support go-live and hypercare, and hand over a fully documented, measurable solution to the client and support teams. You are expected to operate independently on complex processes, mentor junior analysts, and be the person the client trusts to tell them what is genuinely automatable and what is not.

 

**Key Responsibilities**

 

* Lead structured discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, job shadowing and process walkthroughs with business SMEs to capture the true operating process, including exceptions, workarounds and undocumented tribal knowledge.

* Perform automation feasibility and complexity assessment; qualify or disqualify candidate processes against standardisation, rule-clarity, volume, stability and data-quality criteria, and have the confidence to recommend against automation where the business case does not hold.

* Build the business case: quantify AS-IS effort, volumes, FTE cost, error rates and cycle times; model expected benefit, ROI, payback period and effort estimate, and present it to client sponsors for funding approval.

* Capture process metrics and prepare the Process Qualification / Assessment output, including pipeline prioritisation where multiple candidates compete for the same delivery capacity.

* Use Process Mining and Task Mining outputs where available to validate stated process behaviour against actual system event data, rather than relying solely on stakeholder recall.

* Conduct deep-dive "As-Is" analysis to design optimized "To-Be" states, ensuring processes are not just automated, but architected for peak efficiency.

* Author comprehensive Process Design Documents (PDDs) and partner on Solution Designs (SDDs) to ensure absolute logic clarity and traceability.

* Produce end-to-end process maps and flow diagrams (BPMN / Visio / Lucid), covering the happy path, every business exception, every system exception and the defined handling for each.

* Define and baseline detailed functional and non-functional requirements, acceptance criteria, business rules, data dictionaries, input/output specifications and in-scope / out-of-scope boundaries; drive formal sign-off from the process owner before build begins.

* Own the Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) so that every requirement is traceable through design, build, test case and production release.

* Identify and document the AS-IS to TO-BE process re-engineering opportunities, eliminating waste before automating rather than automating an inefficient process as-is.

* Contribute to pre-sales and solutioning activity - discovery for prospects, effort estimation and proposal input - where the account requires it.

 

**Deliverables Owned by This Role**

 

* Process Assessment / Qualification Document and automation business case with ROI model.

* As-Is and To-Be process maps and detailed process flow diagrams.

* Process Definition Document (PDD) and contribution to the Solution Design Document (SDD).

* Functional and non-functional requirements specification with acceptance criteria and business rules.

* Test strategy, test scenarios, test cases, UAT pack and signed UAT closure report.

* Exception handling and business continuity procedure.

* End-user training material, SOPs and user guides.

* Support runbook, escalation matrix and knowledge-transfer pack for handover.

* Post-implementation benefit realisation report.

 

**Must Have Qualifications:**

 

* 5+ years of Business Analysis experience with a dedicated focus on Intelligent Automation, RPA (e.g., UiPath), or AI-driven application engineering, including at least 2 years in a senior or lead analyst capacity.

* Proven understanding of modern AI architectures, with the ability to design workflows that incorporate LLMs, API integrations, and unstructured data processing.

* Demonstrable expertise in authoring rigorous PDDs and collaborating on SDDs with strict traceability.

* Strong track record operating within Agile frameworks, serving as the definitive translation layer between executive business stakeholders and technical engineering pods.

* Migration Fluency: Specific exposure to UiPath.

* Demonstrated end-to-end SDLC ownership: evidence of personally carrying at least three automation or AI initiatives from discovery through production deployment and hypercare, not only the documentation phase.

 

**Strong Plus:**

 

* UiPath Certified Professional Business Analyst (UiBPA).

* Domain depth in Banking and Financial Services, particularly regulated processes with audit and control requirements.

 

**What We Offer:**

* **Medical Insurance:**
  Comprehensive medical insurance fully funded by Roboyo for employees, with the option to extend coverage to eligible family members at the employee’s own cost.
* **Meal Voucher Benefit:**
  Enjoy tax-efficient meal benefits through a Pluxee card, helping you save on everyday meal expenses.
* **A truly international environment**
  , working with talented colleagues and clients on global automation and AI projects.
* **Work at the forefront of Agentic AI and automation**
  , innovating with emerging technologies and helping shape next-generation, future-ready intelligent automation solutions.
* **A growth-focused environment**
  where you are empowered to develop, excel, take ownership, and make a meaningful contribution.
* **Real impact from day one**
  , with the opportunity to bring forward ideas, take initiative, and influence how we work and what we build.
* **A culture shaped by strong values**
  , with human-centric leadership, ownership, integrity, collaboration, and continuous growth at the heart of how we work and succeed together.

 

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
